name: regex_extract
title: Regex Extract
description: Extract text from a string using a regex pattern. Returns the first match as a string, or `null` if no match. With `group` (default 0 = whole match), extracts that capture group. With `all: true`, returns a JSON array of all matches. Missing capture group index yields a clear error.

tool_spec.description: Extract text from a string using a regex pattern. Returns the first match as a string, or `null` if no match. With `group` (default 0 = whole match), extracts that capture group. With `all: true`, returns a JSON array of all matches. Missing capture group index yields a clear error.

all.description: Extract all matches instead of just the first (default false)

group.description: Capture group index to extract (default 0 = whole match)

pattern.description: The regex pattern to match against
